wren.name: Wren, the Orphan
wren.blurb: Quick on her feet. Darts out of trouble with her ghost pup.

keepsake.name: Scarf Thread
keepsake.desc: A warm amber thread from a child's scarf. The Hollow remembers who wore it.

ability.name: Pelt Dash
ability.desc: Dart 130 px the way you are heading with your pup. Untouchable for 0.5 s; foes in the way are knocked aside.

elias.name: Elias, the Priest
elias.blurb: Still and steady. Plants a ring of candles that shelters him.

keepsake.name: Candle Stub
keepsake.desc: A burnt-down votive candle that still smells of wax and warm light.

ability.name: Sanctuary Ring
ability.desc: Plant a ring of candles for 6 s. You heal while you stand inside; foes inside the ring are slowed 20%.

hearthwarden.name: Lucinda, the Hearth-Warden
hearthwarden.blurb: Keeper of the old hearth. Her little dragon Ophimber rises and breathes three rings of warm fire.

ability.name: Ophimber's Rise
ability.desc: Ophimber rises and breathes three rings of fire round you, each further out. Each ring burns for 3 s. Fire never hurts you.
